subject: Kickoff expectations
body: Good to get started, though I'll be upfront that leadership is watching this one closely given how the legacy system has burned us before with other vendors. Let's start strong.

subject: Missed integration test window
body: This is the third missed test window this month. Each time it pushes our downstream teams' schedules. I need to understand what is actually going wrong here, not just that there was 'an unexpected issue.'

subject: Second follow-up on test windows
body: Another missed window this week. I raised this seven days ago and nothing has visibly changed. I need a real explanation, not a repeat apology.

subject: Unacceptable
body: I found out from my own team that the API mapping was wrong, not from your team, even though this has apparently been known for a week. I should not be the last to know about problems on my own program.

subject: RE: escalation call recap
body: Thanks for the call today. To be clear, I'm holding your team to the root cause analysis you committed to delivering today. I'll be tracking this closely.

subject: Escalating to your engagement partner
body: I've asked for a root cause analysis twice and haven't received one. I'm looping in your engagement partner because I no longer feel confident this workstream will self-correct without leadership involvement on your side.

subject: Still waiting on the RCA
body: It has now been over a week since your engagement partner committed to a root cause analysis. I have still not received it. This is exactly the pattern I raised on the escalation call.

subject: Trust concerns ahead of QBR prep
body: Ahead of next week's QBR, I want to be direct that trust with this workstream is very low right now. I intend to raise the full history in that session unless something changes materially before then.

subject: Formal concerns ahead of QBR
body: Ahead of the QBR I want it on record that this workstream has not met a milestone on time since May. We are evaluating whether this scope should be restructured or reassigned. Please come prepared to discuss both options.

subject: QBR outcome and next steps
body: Following the QBR, I want to be transparent: our leadership is now formally evaluating whether to move this workstream to a different vendor. The revised plan you presented was a reasonable start, but it will take sustained delivery, not another slide, to change that trajectory.
